statement: Lea's birthday is 10 days after Sam's birthday. Sam's birthday is on a Friday. Lea's party is on the day before her birthday. On which day of the week is the party?

choices.misconception: I thought 10 days later lands on the same day of the week, like 7 days later does, so the birthday was a Friday and the party a Thursday.
I counted Friday itself as the first of the 10 days, so I got Sunday for the birthday and then went back one day.
I found the day of Lea's birthday and forgot that her party is the day before.
I went one day after Lea's birthday instead of one day before.

hints: What day of the week is it 7 days after a Friday?
A whole week later is always the same day of the week. Jump most of the 10 days at once, count the rest one day at a time, then step back one day for the party.
7 days after Friday is Friday again. Count the 3 days that are left: Saturday, Sunday, then one more. Then step back one day.

solutions.reliable: 7 days after Friday is Friday again, so 7 of the 10 days bring us back to Friday. Count the other 3 days: Saturday is 1, Sunday is 2 and Monday is 3. So Lea's birthday is on a Monday. The party is the day before, which is Sunday. The idea to keep: a whole week later is always the same day of the week, so jump in weeks first.
solutions.elegant: 10 days forward and then 1 day back is the same as 9 days forward. 9 days is one week and 2 more days, so the party is 2 days after a Friday, which is Sunday. The idea to keep: join the moves into one, then take out the whole weeks.

whyOnTest: Days of the week repeat every 7 days: jumping a whole week first makes 10 days easy, and the question is about the party, not the birthday.
author: Devansh Sanghavi
